description: This Dart file defines the HomeActivity widget and its state, implementing the main navigation shell for a Flutter application. It includes a Scaffold with an AppBar and a Drawer populated with several navigation items. The widget manages state to switch between different fragments/pages such as Home, COVID19, Payment, and others, based on user interaction with the drawer. It also displays user profile information dynamically loaded via constructor parameters or preferences.

classes.name: HomeActivity
classes.description: A StatefulWidget representing the main activity screen, managing navigation and user profile display.

classes.name: _HomeActivityState
classes.description: State class for HomeActivity, managing drawer selection, app bar title, and rendering the appropriate fragment.

classes.name: _DrawerItem
classes.description: A simple model class holding icon and label data for drawer items.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for this widget.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the state, setting user display name and email from widget parameters or preferences.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the entire Scaffold with AppBar, Drawer, and body based on current state.

methods.name: _buildDrawer
methods.description: Builds the Drawer widget containing header and navigation items.

methods.name: _buildBody
methods.description: Returns the appropriate fragment widget based on the selected drawer index.

methods.name: _onDrawerItemTapped
methods.description: Updates selected index and title when a drawer item is tapped.
